chunks.text: GSTR-1 is the return for outward supplies. For monthly filers it is due on the 11th of the following month. For quarterly filers under the QRMP scheme it is due on the 13th of the month after the quarter.

GSTR-3B is the monthly summary return with tax payment. For monthly filers it is due on the 20th of the following month. For quarterly filers under the QRMP scheme it is due on the 22nd or 24th of the month after the quarter, depending on the state.
Standard due dates are extended only by notification. A due date does not move for a Sunday or a holiday unless notified. Check the GST portal before each filing cycle.

title: GST return filing due dates: GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B
